text_block_list.text:
One day, while preparing for the summer 
training camp, Yamanin Zephyr said to me, 
"There is something I wish to speak with 
you about."

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Regarding the upcoming summer training 
camp—

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Would it be possible for me to train 
alongside Bakushin O-san and Flower-san as 
much as possible?

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Yes. To me, they belong to a generation 
below, but—

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Possessing speed like a raging gale, 
Sakura Bakushin O continues her triumphant 
charge in the sprint races.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Possessing skill on par with even Bakushin 
O-san, Nishino Flower-san is a lovely yet 
fearsome gale of flowers.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
All of them are up-and-coming sprint 
Umamusume who have declared their entry 
into this year's Sprinters Stakes—

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
In other words, for those of us aiming to 
conquer the sprint division, these two are 
the greatest storm we will ever face.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
But that is precisely why. I want to 
compete with you as much as I can.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Trainer. I've learned what it means to 
become the wind, sweeping up the fans, my 
fellow racers, and everyone around me.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
That is precisely why, during this summer, 
I will push even further.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
"I wish to bathe thoroughly in those 
explosive winds, those flower-scented 
gales, swallow it all whole, and make it 
my strength."
To be honest—I was taken by surprise.

Just when did Yamanin Zephyr grow this 
much?

She was no longer the fierce yet fragile 
girl she once was. Possessing a soul 
purer, stronger, and fiercer than anyone 
else's— Yamanin Zephyr was...

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Please. So that I may become a true, even 
fiercer tempest.

She had broadened her horizons so much 
that she could now dive headfirst into 
adversity and turn every bit of it into 
strength.

Truly, like the all-encompassing 
atmosphere— and the wind born forth from 
it.
choice_data_list: Got it! I'll get it adjusted right away—

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Is it right here?!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
"Called upon! Springing into action! The 
Class Rep!! Yes! It is I, Sakura Bakushin 
O!!!!"

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Ah, u-um, I'm Nishino Flower...!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Um, we were actually looking for you 
because we wanted to talk to you too, 
Zephyr-san...!!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Joint training during summer camp?! Why, 
that sounds splendid!! Let us definitely 
do it! Absolutely, positively, by all 
means!!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
And Zephyr-san. For the main event, the 
Sprinters Stakes—

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
With the Class Rep Wind!! I shall blow it 
all away for you!!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Ah...!? M-Me too! Um... I-I'm Flower 
Wind!!

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: Oh my... Fufufu.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
I accept your challenge. As the Zephyr 
wind.
